metadata.method: Independent TypeScript AST pattern reader. Original functions, callbacks, constructors, imports, expressions and Phaser APIs are not executed. Wave ranges enumerate only our independently normalized IR.
metadata.enumProvenance: Numeric enums come from the separately AST-extracted rogue-world-reference.json at the same fixed upstream commit.

semantics.choices: Preserve order and duplicate entries. uniform-config-choice means choose a config template index uniformly at trainer construction, then retain that index. No RNG draw is executed by this importer.
semantics.functionPrecedence: partyTemplateFunc takes precedence over configChoices; later setPartyTemplates does not clear an existing function.
semantics.compound: slots expose getStrength/getEvoThresholdKind/isSameSpecies/isBalanced per index. rootEvoThresholdKind separately exposes the superclass field used by the generic NPC path; compound root remains NORMAL.
semantics.groups: groupStart preserves sameSpecies group offsets. Slots in one group share its flags and threshold. Compound children are concatenated in source order.
semantics.gym: Classic source has five ranges: <=20, <=30, <=60, <=90, otherwise. Do not fabricate a sixth classic gym stage.
semantics.doubleBattles: This table describes source party templates before battle-variant processing. Trainer.getPartyLevels raises a size-1 double template to size2; named double roster overrides remain separate.
semantics.scope: Template selection/composition only. Does not implement roster callbacks, evolution, movesets, items, battles or trainer AI.
